segments.name: Energy
segments.description: An integrated energy company producing natural gas and NGLs, operating midstream systems, generating natural gas-fired power, and developing carbon capture, utilization and sequestration projects.
segments.evidence: Our operations are supported by four business lines: natural gas production, natural gas midstream, power generation, and CCUS.

revenueModel.text: BKV earns revenue from selling produced natural gas and NGLs, from midstream services, power generation, and from CCUS projects for third parties.
revenueModel.evidence: In addition to lowering emissions in our owned and operated upstream and natural gas midstream businesses, CCUS for third parties is a focus of our business plan.

changes.text: In 2024, BKV sold BKV Chaffie Corners and certain non-operated upstream assets in Chelsea.
changes.evidence: On June 14, 2024, BKV sold BKV Chaffee Corners, LLC ("Chaffee"), and on June 28, 2024, sold certain of its non-operated upstream assets in Chelsea.

changes.text: In 2025, BKV acquired Bedrock Production, LLC, adding Barnett Shale producing properties and midstream assets.
changes.evidence: On September 29, 2025, BKV Upstream Midstream acquired 100 % of the equity interests of Bedrock Production, LLC (now known as BKV Barnett II, LLC ("BKV Barnett II")), a Texas limited liability company (such transaction, the "Bedrock Acquisition") from Bedrock Energy Partners, LLC (the "Seller"), pursuant to a Membership Purchase Agreement (the "Bedrock Purchase Agreement").
